closed_findings.problem: Existing --lock parsers accept original21 schema, not new R1 remediation lock; comparison package-id also filters original lock; universe validate_delivery/check_handoff is hardcoded to old directory/ID with no public --handoff. Current card lacks explicit requirement for selecting new remediation handoff and validating two distinct lock roles, risking old-valid handoff being mistaken for R1 validation.
closed_findings.requested_change: Clarify original verify-inputs/demo use original21 lock/base package ID; require explicit new-R1 handoff/package selection and separate remediation baseline/extra-source checks with compatible CLI extension/mode. Require actual commands in new report and a negative test proving old delivery alone cannot satisfy R1. No new microgate or owner/production feature.
closed_findings.resolution: Shared rules new§5 explicitly distinguishes original21 versus remediation lock/IDs, new handoff target and compatible CLI extension with real final help/argv. Requires R1-specific negatives; immutable references versus mutable initial target baseline clarified in lock_semantics; final review binds remediation lock rawSHA. No new production API or microgate.
